answer.reason: The verses tell how the table was made and how it was set up in the tent with the bread upon it.

clauses.english: was made of shittim wood and overlaid with pure gold
clauses.quote: And he overlaid it with pure gold

clauses.english: was put in the tent of the congregation and had the bread set in order upon it before the LORD
clauses.quote: And he set the bread in order upon it before the LORD
